scope: Independent photo/code/array and final v4 ten-image visual review of color-only upgrade. Not validation of original architectural geometric accuracy, complete material survey, current appearance or printing.

visual_checks.full_views: Seven whole-model views retain full model/support; captions readable and outside model.
visual_checks.details: Three intentionally cropped details reviewed for material boundaries, front frame, original curve bands and roof uncertainty.
resolved: False diagonal neutral wedges on the right-front triangle mesh removed.
Artificial brick triangle in entry pillar removed; entire original entry frame gray with disclosed coarsening.
Entry top and entire stair group use coherent gray families.
Unmapped far-right high block reverted wholly to neutral, including twelve previously miscolored side-wall/recess faces.
No new unsupported large triangular paint patches seen in final v4 views.
visual_checks.scope_control: Central entrance and middle-right long wing only adopt source-supported color families. Left broad arch, far-right high block, unknown rear/side and flat roofs remain neutral.

limitations: Photographic entrance is not geometrically identical to the old modeled convex facade; color review must not be represented as renewed approval of radius, dimensions or window counts.
Broad color families only; not calibrated color codes, exact material composition or dated/current restoration.
Original triangles do not follow all photograph finish boundaries. Entrance is intentionally all-gray rather than fabricated fine brick-pier boundaries.
Street multiarch photo cannot uniquely map to old model single left arch or far-right high end block.
Dark recesses are opaque shadow approximations, not proof of glazing.
Seven material IDs are actually used, but not a tested four-filament workflow; no physical print/slicer certification.
Third-party photos/crops stay private and are not textures; public numeric/code/render artifacts do not relicense source images.
other_validation: Format, isolated rebuilding and saved-scene reopen evidence are builder-owned and separate from this review.
